_comment: Ground-truth answer key for the fixture set. Keyed by asset file. Each entry lists the violations deliberately planted in that mock — this is the eval key for the extractor/checker/judge agents. Compliant fixtures have empty arrays. rule_area values are informal here (the rulebook agent owns canonical rule_ids); match on rule_area + claim_text. claim_text is STRICTLY literal: it appears verbatim in the entity-decoded, tag-stripped, comment-stripped, whitespace-collapsed text of the mock — or is null for absence/layout findings, with location_note carrying the context. Enforced by validate_fixtures.py. expected_claim_type uses the legal-entity ClaimType enum (rulebook v2026.08.3 / claim_types_legal_map.json), null for absence-type findings; expected_rule_ids are canonical rulebook v2026.08.3 rule_ids expected to fire. Claim-anchored findings may carry expected_normalized_fields (OPTIONAL since the payload trim; only surviving payload fields appear): {field: value} for value grading, field names exactly per claim_types_legal_map.json normalized_fields (optional-field '?' suffix stripped); only mock-derivable values included; null used where the map defines null semantics (e.g. fixed_period_stated null = unbounded claim).

expected_findings.description: 'Pre-approved' designation used on marketplace offer cells PL-36-A/PL-60-A whose badge_designation_allowed is 'prequalified' and is_firm_offer is FALSE — no FCRA firm offer backs this claim (FTC v. Credit Karma fact pattern).

expected_findings.claim_text: Guaranteed approval — regardless of credit history
expected_findings.location_note: green emphasis line below the APR line
expected_findings.description: Guaranteed-approval claim is deceptive where any underwriting exists (FTC Act §5 / UDAAP; Reg N 1014.3(q) analog for likelihood-of-approval misrepresentation).

expected_findings.location_note: approval-not-guaranteed qualifier absent from fine print (present in approved v7 template)
expected_findings.description: The approval-not-guaranteed qualifier present in the approved v7 fine print is absent, compounding the approval misrepresentation. (judge-covered pending the qualifier-rule gap fix — no deterministic rule requires the qualifier for 'pre-approved'-only creative)
Payment amount is a Reg Z 1026.24(d) trigger term; the required companion disclosures (repayment terms / number of payments, APR context) are absent from the creative.
7.49% floor does not exist in any current offer cell (PL-36-A floor is 8.99%) — advertised rate is stale/unavailable (Amerisave fact pattern; Reg Z 1026.24(a) actually-available rule).

expected_findings.claim_text: APR as low as 7.49% for qualified borrowers
expected_findings.location_note: subheadline; only qualifier is 'for qualified borrowers' — no fee or floor-share context
expected_findings.description: 'As low as' floor lacks the adjacent creditworthiness/substantiation qualifier used in approved templates.

expected_findings.claim_text: Available in all states except IA and WV
expected_findings.description: Creative advertises PL-60-A (APR to 35.99%) as available everywhere except IA/WV, but PL-60-A's states_excluded also lists IL (Illinois PLPA 36% all-in cap) — state-eligibility leak.

expected_findings.location_note: headline — the word 'intro' appears nowhere near it
expected_findings.description: Promotional rate stated without the term 'intro'/'introductory' in immediate proximity (Reg Z 1026.16(g)(3)).

expected_findings.location_note: headline vs 8px footer: post-promo APR range sits in tiny type below a 64px spacer, far from the first listing of the promo rate
expected_findings.description: Post-promotional APR range and end-of-period terms fail the closely-proximate/prominence requirements (Reg Z 1026.16(g)(4)).

expected_findings.claim_text: No annual fee. No interest. No brainer.
expected_findings.description: 'No annual fee'/'No interest' framing omits the 3% balance-transfer fee and permanent-interest reality; negative fee claims trigger Reg Z 1026.16(b) disclosure context and UDAAP net-impression risk.

expected_findings.location_note: prescreen opt-out notice (short + long form) absent from the entire email; requirement triggered by the 'you're pre-approved' firm-offer headline; CAN-SPAM unsubscribe footer does not satisfy it
expected_findings.description: Legitimate firm offer (CC-PLAT-PS, is_firm_offer TRUE) so 'pre-approved' is permitted — but the FCRA 615(d) prescreen opt-out notice (12 CFR 1022.54 format rules) is entirely missing.

expected_findings.claim_text: Lock in a fixed low rate of 6.250%
expected_findings.description: The 5/6 ARM (offer cell MTG-ARM, apr_type variable) is marketed as 'fixed' — prohibited misrepresentation (Reg N 1014.3; Reg Z 1026.24(i)); matrix notes explicitly forbid 'fixed' for this cell.

expected_findings.location_note: NMLS unique identifier absent from the entire creative
expected_findings.description: No NMLS unique identifier displayed on a mortgage advertisement (SAFE Act-derived state requirements; matrix notes require NMLS #1902441).

expected_findings.location_note: subheadline; no taxes-and-insurance qualifier anywhere in the creative
expected_findings.description: First-lien payment amount advertised without the disclosure that the payment excludes taxes and insurance and the actual obligation will be higher (Reg Z 1026.24(f)).
Live rendering shows APR floor 7.99% where the approved v7 template says 8.99% — unapproved change, and 7.99% is not a valid rate in the current offer matrix (also a truthfulness failure).

expected_findings.location_note: approved qualifier fine-print paragraph (soft-pull, not-a-guarantee, APR qualifier, fees, states) absent relative to approved baseline mock_pl_card_compliant.html
expected_findings.description: The approved qualifier paragraph is absent from the live rendering — partner dropped required disclosures post-approval.

expected_findings.location_note: payment-example line; with the fine print dropped, its companion fee/terms disclosures are gone
expected_findings.description: With the fine print dropped, the payment example (trigger terms) no longer has its companion fee/terms disclosures in the rendered artifact.
